D3 ruling rule G10, for P02, written before its lines are ruled: P02 is shown when a concept shows a member or the room choosing, proposing or changing what the mark shows: naming the picture to make (a proposal, even unanswered; a call that names the picture shows P01 and P02's lower range at once), arguing or voting on its design, taking the land's flag, emblems or the room's own logo as the mark by a stated choice, deciding to sign it or not, claiming or adopting a mark others made, adding to or enlarging the mark, or adding a personal piece. A concept that only announces, shows, locates, defends or admires a mark already placed shows the result and not the settling: for P02 it is an evidence limit (it may show R01, P03, P05 or P12). A call that names no picture (help our spot) does not show P02. Under G2, an absent line is rejected when its concepts show P02 by this rule
